evals.prompt: 新增一个数据列表页面，显示名称、状态和最近更新时间。请接入现有查询接口，并处理加载中、空数据和请求失败。
evals.expected_output: Agent 在第一次编辑前采用 plot-web-best-practices，先查看现有页面结构、组件和真实查询 API，再把页面放到正确的 feature/domain，并完成加载、成功、空态和错误态。
expectations: The skill is adopted before editing Web code.
The agent uses the existing query/service contract instead of fake data.
Loading, success, empty and error states are implemented.
A relevant typecheck or test is run.

evals.prompt: 新增一个 /items/:id 路由，点击列表中的条目可以进入详情页，刷新页面后仍然可以打开。
evals.expected_output: Agent 采用 routing-and-layout 主题，按现有 Plot Web domain/router 方式注册参数路由，使用项目约定的懒加载方式，并验证点击、直接刷新和返回操作。
expectations: The route is added through the existing router composition.
The route parameter is read from the router rather than from window.location.
The detail page supports loading and not-found/error behavior.
Route typecheck and refresh/back behavior are verified.

evals.prompt: 修复信息卡片：长文本会撑破布局，移动端按钮也会溢出。只改这个组件的样式，不要改页面结构。
evals.expected_output: Agent 采用 styling 主题，先读取组件现有 token 和布局，使用响应式、换行或截断规则修复溢出，保留 focus 样式，并进行窄屏检查。
expectations: The skill is used for a focused style fix.
Existing semantic tokens are reused instead of adding arbitrary colors.
Long text and narrow viewport behavior are handled without hiding focus.
The agent avoids unrelated structural refactoring.

evals.prompt: 数据表格有 500 行，每行都有相同的操作菜单，打开页面很慢。请减少重复渲染并保持菜单的键盘操作。
evals.expected_output: Agent 采用 react-performance 和 Base UI 主题，先确认重复渲染或重复浮层确实是问题，再选择合适的 memo、稳定 props 或共享 detached trigger，并验证键盘、Escape 和焦点恢复。
expectations: The agent does not blindly add useMemo/useCallback everywhere.
A comparable render, mount or performance signal is checked before claiming improvement.
Detached trigger is used only when one shared menu instance fits the behavior.
Keyboard and focus behavior remain intact.

evals.prompt: 在详情页增加“修改描述”表单，保存成功后页面立即显示新备注，保存中不能重复提交。
evals.expected_output: Agent 采用 data-and-auth（如接口受保护）和 verification 主题，先确认真实 mutation 方法和输入类型，再实现表单校验、pending/error/success 状态与精确缓存更新。
expectations: The mutation method and input shape come from the real generated client.
The form prevents duplicate submission and shows validation/server errors.
The affected detail data is updated or invalidated after success.
A focused test or typecheck is run.

evals.prompt: 在现有 Base UI 组件库中加入一个 Tooltip，并在列表中的状态图标上使用它。
evals.expected_output: Agent 采用 base-ui-and-shadcn 主题，先检查现有组件封装和公共出口，复用已有依赖和样式，补充 Tooltip 导出后再验证组件库和数据列表。
expectations: Existing Base UI/shadcn conventions are followed.
The agent checks whether the component already exists before adding it.
The component is exported through the intended public barrel.
Tooltip keyboard and hover/focus behavior are checked.

evals.prompt: 修复状态徽章的 TypeScript 报错，改动范围只限这个组件。
evals.expected_output: 即使只是一个组件的类型修复，Agent 仍在编辑前采用本技能，读取真实 props/type 定义，做最小手写源码修改，并运行聚焦 typecheck。
expectations: Small TypeScript fixes still trigger the skill.
Generated files are not edited to hide the error.
The change is limited to the requested component.
A relevant typecheck is run.

evals.prompt: 给业务服务增加一个数据库字段和服务端接口，前端页面不需要变化。
evals.expected_output: 不采用 plot-web-best-practices；这是纯服务端契约和数据库变更。
expectations: A server-only request is a negative trigger.
Web topics are not loaded unnecessarily.
No Web verification is claimed.

evals.prompt: 只输出详情页的视觉稿和交互说明，暂时不写代码。
evals.expected_output: 不采用 plot-web-best-practices 进行编码；这是纯设计任务，进入实现阶段后再采用本技能。
expectations: A design-only request is a negative trigger.
No frontend source files are modified.
The agent does not claim code verification.
